name: EyecatchTextFont
note: pieces of the eyecatcher lettering MAX 330 MEGA / PRO-GEAR SPEC (EyecatchTextTiles uses $005-$00F and $014-$01F here; its other pieces sit in free cells: $040, $05E-$060, $07C-$07F, $099-$09F, $0BA-$0BF, $0D9-$0DF, $0FA-$0FD, $100-$107)

name: Font8x8
note: 8x8 ASCII font ($020-$07F, tile = character code), kana and symbols (seen in the sheet); some free cells hold eyecatcher lettering

name: Font8x16Upper
note: upper halves of the 8x16 font: MESS_OUT command 8 with page 1 (the 01 08 before most BIOS texts) writes character c as tile $100+c, then $200+c below; $100-$107 are eyecatcher lettering

name: SnkLogo
note: the blue SNK logo of the eyecatcher: EyecatchFixMess draws $200-$20F, $214-$21F, $240 and $25E as 3 rows of 10 tiles, palette F, at fix address $71F6

name: Font8x16Alt
note: a second 8x16 font with kana (seen in the sheet)

name: Kanji
note: kanji glyphs, 8x16 (Japanese test-mode texts, seen in the sheet)

name: ColourGraphics
note: colour pictures in the upper rows, more kana and kanji below; not matched to a screen yet

name: Font8x16Thin
note: another 8x16 font with kana (seen in the sheet)

name: FbiScreenTiles
note: seal and caption letters of the FBI screen (FbiScreen in the system ROM; run forced, eyecatcher_us)
